_readme: Videos shown on videos.html. Add a new upload as one entry: id = the YouTube video id, format = "video" (16:9) or "short" (9:16). paper.title must match the paper's "name" in academic-publications.json to show a Video button on the Publications page. A video without a paper can have a short "note" instead.

videos.title: ACML: Model Reality. Build What's Next.
videos.summary: A short film about the lab: the questions we model, the tools we build, and the partners we build them with.

videos.title: Mismatched Socks, Explained by Math (and One Very Lonely Sock)
videos.summary: Should you wear mismatched socks? Lefty the orphan sock and our narrator walk through the model, the user study and the simulations.

paper.title: Service Preservation from Matching Non-Matching Socks Under Stochastic Loss
paper.label: Explore the study

videos.title: The Shadow Economy in Sweden: Geography Matters
videos.summary: Follow the cash: modelling Sweden's informal economy region by region, and why a region's neighbours help predict it.

paper.title: Tell Me Who Your Neighbors Are and I Will Tell You Your Informal Economy Size: The Case of Sweden

videos.title: Symbolic Distillation in Neural Networks
videos.summary: Opening the black box: distilling a trained neural network into equations people can read.

paper.title: Interpretable knowledge distillation via symbolic regression for feedforward neural networks

videos.title: Can We Really Map Pandemics to Graphs?
videos.summary: Turning detailed spatial epidemic models into graphs that keep most of the accuracy for a fraction of the computing time.

paper.title: Transforming norm-based to graph-based spatial representation for spatio-temporal epidemiological models

paper.title: Inducing state anxiety in LLM agents reproduces human-like biases in consumer decision-making

paper.title: Bi-national academic funding and collaboration dynamics: the case of the German-Israeli foundation
